description: Read one library item's AI-ready manifest (schema hiruai.media-library.v1): provenance and reuse guidance, renditions, catalog (summary, chapters, reusable_segments, voice_reference_candidates, generation_prompts, sensitive flags), scenes with spoken text and OCR. Book-mode items also include book_pages (ordered OCR, observed printed_page, source timestamp/frame, confidence and warnings) and book_analysis coverage limits. Never infer missing pages or treat OCR scores as verified accuracy. include_transcript adds every timed transcript segment. Respect reuse_policy: "reusable" footage (own/licensed) may be cut into new work; "reference_only" third-party media is for analysis, structure and style reference only, never copied into an output.

include_transcript.description: Include every timed transcript segment in the manifest.

item_id.description: UUID of the media library item.

name: media_library_get
title: Get media library item
